references.text: John the Baptist fulfills the prophecy of one crying out in the wilderness, preparing the way for the Lord
John the Baptist is recognized as a prophet, and this verse highlights the significance of the prophet's role
The people's recognition of Jesus as a prophet connects to John's role in preparing the way for Jesus
Jesus confirms that John was a prophet, and more than a prophet, paralleling the statement in Matthew
John the Baptist testifies about the light but is not the light himself, emphasizing his role as a prophet
John identifies himself as 'the voice crying out in the wilderness,' directly linked to the prophecy
